automations.name: RAKBANK morning cashback scan
automations.prompt: Run the live cashback scan for source RAKBANK_CARD_TRANSACTION with durable cursor outlook:rakbank. Follow agents/automations/live-cashback-scan.md exactly. If and only if the run succeeds completely, archive this task; never archive a failed or partial run.

automations.name: Standard Chartered morning cashback scan

This task stays paused until that source is ACTIVE and its real message fixture and parser pass tests.

automations.prompt: Run the authoritative monthly statement cycle for RAK_WORLD on day 6 after its day-5 close. Follow agents/automations/statement-cycle.md exactly. The placeholder source must remain non-importing until a real statement and mailbox contract are verified.

automations.name: Standard Chartered Platinum X monthly statement reconciliation
automations.prompt: Run the authoritative monthly statement cycle for SC_PLATINUM_X on day 6 after its day-5 close. Follow agents/automations/statement-cycle.md exactly. This task stays paused until a real statement, mailbox contract, and parser are verified.

automations.name: Emirates Islamic Amazon monthly statement reconciliation
automations.prompt: Run the authoritative monthly statement cycle for EI_AMAZON on day 1 after its month-end close. Follow agents/automations/statement-cycle.md exactly. EI is statement-only for live totals and uses its statement for cashback close.

automations.name: Wio monthly statement ingestion
automations.prompt: Run the authoritative monthly statement cycle for WIO_CREDIT on day 3 because statements arrive on day 1 or 2. Follow agents/automations/statement-cycle.md exactly. Map card suffix 4113 and account suffix 5009 to the single Actual account Wio Credit Card · 4113 / 5009; never split this credit product into separate accounts. Wio is outside the live cashback companion.
